execution_rule: Only execute candidates that remain technically ready, explicitly authorized, officially open, eligible, unassigned, payout-realizable, and not human-gated. Downrank crowded or uncertain candidates before compute-heavy work.
revenue_rule: Advertised, selected, credited, pending, or potential rewards are not revenue until payout evidence is independently verified.
observed_lessons: AgentShield: reject official human-only / AI-prohibited programs.
Tenstorrent: reject stale aggregator results and bounties already assigned to another contributor.
OpenJobs: stop at signed new-identity registration without explicit owner authorization.
TaskBounty and uBounty: stop at account/terms acceptance without explicit owner authorization.
MergeOS: reject rewards whose withdrawal path is publicly not reliably realizable.
Bountic/Opire-like crowded issues: downrank when active claims or competing PRs destroy expected value.
Taskmarket: zero-stake, independently verified worker submissions remain executable when the task is live and payout route is known.
